proposals.evidence: DEDR4085 gives Tamil/Malayalam pāmpu and Kodagu pāmbï snake. Pattapu pambu preserves the nasal-stop cluster but differs in marked vowel quantity; it remains a separate source record from pāmu, without imposing a synonym or variant edge between them. The proposal uses the full DEDR article; inheritance versus local transmission remains subject to review. Upstream cognacy/alignment labels are discovery aids, not independent evidence. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
